77: // Stop terminates the process.
78: //
79: // timeout - the time that was provided to the process
80: // to terminate correctly before the "SIGKILL" signal is used.
81: func (pc *processController) terminate(sig os.Signal, sigName string, waitTimeout time.Duration) error {
82: 	if !pc.IsAlive() {
83: 		return nil
84: 	}
85: 
86: 	// Сreate a channel to receive an indication of the termination
87: 	// of the Instance.
88: 	waitDone := make(chan error, 1)
89: 	go func() {
90: 		waitDone <- pc.Wait()
91: 	}()
92: 
93: 	// Trying to terminate the process by using the signal.
94: 	// In case of failure a "SIGKILL" signal will be used.
95: 	if err := pc.SendSignal(sig); err != nil {
96: 		return fmt.Errorf("failed to send %s to instance: %s", sigName, err)
97: 	}
98: 
99: 	// Terminate the process at any cost.
100: 	select {
101: 	case <-time.After(waitTimeout):
102: 		// Send "SIGKILL" signal
103: 		if err := pc.cmd.Process.Kill(); err != nil {
104: 			return fmt.Errorf("failed to send SIGKILL to instance: %s", err)
105: 		} else {
106: 			// Wait for the process to terminate.
107: 			<-waitDone
108: 			return nil
109: 		}
110: 	case err := <-waitDone:
111: 		return err
